chain.label: National Airlines' cargo operations manual had deficient, incorrect procedures for restraining special cargo loads
chain.trigger: National Airlines' inadequate procedures for restraining special cargo loads

chain.label: FAA's inadequate oversight of National Airlines' handling of special cargo loads
chain.trigger: Contributing to the accident was the FAA's inadequate oversight of National Airlines' handling of special cargo loads

chain.label: Loadmaster directed insufficient, improperly configured tie-down straps to secure the MRAP vehicles
chain.trigger: the loadmaster directed NAC personnel to use 24 straps to secure each M-ATV and 26 straps to secure each Cougar

caused_by.evidence: the procedures were deficient to the extent that, if followed, they could not have enabled him to properly load and restrain a special cargo load
the FAA did not provide adequate oversight to ensure that the National Airlines cargo operations manual reflected the correct information

chain.label: Flight crew and loadmaster did not recognize cargo shifting and strap failures on the prior leg as a serious restraint problem
chain.trigger: they did not recognize that this indicated a serious problem with the cargo restraint methods

caused_by.evidence: some of the cargo had moved, some tie-down straps had become loose, and one strap had broken sometime during the flight from Camp Bastion to Bagram

although the flight crewmembers and the loadmaster were aware that the cargo moved during the previous flight, they did not recognize that this indicated a serious problem

chain.label: Hydraulic systems No. 1 and 2 damaged by the aft-moving M-ATV

caused_by.evidence: Damage observed on the horizontal stabilizer jackscrew assembly and support structure...provide further evidence that the rear M-ATV moved aft until it struck these components

a shift of the horizontal stabilizer...resulted in an inability of the available flight control surfaces to counter the resulting nose-up pitching moment
